acip: BCOM LDAN 'DAS KYIS THUGS BRTZE BAR DGONGS TE, THOS NA CI NAS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD BLA NA MED PA YANG DAG PAR RDZOGS PA'I BYANG CHUB LAS SLAR MI LDOG PAR 'GYUR BA DANG, SDIG PA THAMS CAD DANG, LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD YONGS SU BYANG ZHING YONGS SU BAS PAR 'GYUR BA DANG, BDUD SDIG CAN GYIS MI BRDZI BAR 'GYUR BA'I DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA DE DAG GI MTSAN DANG, SNGON GYI SMON LAM GYI KHYAD PAR RGYAS PA DANG, SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHING GI YON TAN BKOD PA'I GNAS RNAMS BSHAD DU GSOL,
wylie: bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse bar dgongs te, thos na ci nas sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las slar mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang, sdig pa thams cad dang, las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing yongs su bas par 'gyur ba dang, bdud sdig can gyis mi brdzi bar 'gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi mtshan dang, sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa dang, sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i gnas rnams bshad du gsol
english: O Conqueror, we ask that you look upon us with the love of your heart, and elucidate for us the holy names of certain Enlightened Beings Who Have Gone That Way; and the details of the prayers that they made in days gone by; and the wonders of the enlightened realms in which they dwell.  For we know that when any being in the universe hears these things, they become unstoppable in their own journey to the state of matchless and total Buddhahood.  When they hear these things, they are completely cleaned of each and every bad deed they have ever done—each one of these actions comes to an utter end.
